method: One primary event per day, chosen by guarantee / buy-in among that day's verified single-entry events. The conditional fallback is the next-best event that starts after the primary's official late-registration close. Overlaps are flagged using only official start times and official late-registration close times, because no official source publishes a finish time.
note: No verified single-entry event in this dataset starts before 10:10 AM, so a full day of play beginning at 8 AM is not supported by the official schedules read. Registration OPENING times are not printed on any official schedule read; the schedules print a registration CLOSE time per event.
